description: This source file contains classes and methods for testing and resolving custom fonts (Rotis fonts) within the PDFsharp library, including font resolution logic, font data loading, and rendering snippets for specific font styles.

classes.name: RotisWinAnsiTester
classes.description: Class for testing the rendering of Rotis fonts with WinAnsi encoding.

classes.name: RotisWinAnsiSnippet
classes.description: Class that renders a snippet demonstrating different Rotis font styles.

classes.name: RotisFontResolver
classes.description: Implements font resolving logic for Rotis fonts, including font data retrieval and typeface resolution.

classes.name: RotisFontDataHelper
classes.description: Provides embedded font data for various Rotis font styles and weights.

methods.name: RotisWinAnsiTester.RotisWinAnsiTest
methods.description: Method that triggers rendering of the font snippet as a PDF.

methods.name: RotisWinAnsiSnippet.RenderSnippet
methods.description: Renders text with different Rotis font styles onto a graphics context.

methods.name: RotisFontResolver.ResolveTypeface
methods.description: Resolves font typefaces based on family name, bold, and italic flags, with special handling for Rotis fonts.

methods.name: RotisFontResolver.GetFont
methods.description: Retrieves font data bytes for a given face name.

methods.name: RotisFontDataHelper.LoadFontData
methods.description: Loads embedded font data from resources.
